# TextDecorationInput

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

[`TextDecoration`](text-decoration.md) is a bit-flags set, so it also accepts a list of tokens for combinations - `['underline', 'overline']`.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
type TextDecorationInput = TextDecoration | TextDecorationToken | readonly TextDecorationToken[]
```
